feature.text: The only solution, the only solution for us and for the world is the gospel that rescues us from that sin.

lines.text: Our passage this morning has one point for us to consider: no one, no one is innocent before God on the strength of what they do.
We cannot truly believe the Gospel if we do not believe we need the Gospel. And not just needing it like, I did need it at one time, but always continually needing it.
The only thing that makes the Jewish people significant, the only thing, is God alone. That's it. God alone makes this people significant.
The only solution, the only solution for us and for the world is the gospel that rescues us from that sin.
